description: This Java source file defines the 'TensorFlowObjectDetectionAPIModel' class, which implements the 'Classifier' interface. It wraps a frozen TensorFlow object detection model, providing methods to load the model and labels, preprocess input images, run inference, and output detected objects with bounding boxes and confidence scores.

classes.name: TensorFlowObjectDetectionAPIModel
classes.description: A class that wraps a TensorFlow object detection model, providing image recognition capabilities and manages model inference lifecycle.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Initializes and loads the TensorFlow model and labels, returning an instance of the classifier.

methods.name: recognizeImage
methods.description: Performs object detection on a provided Bitmap image and returns a list of recognition results.

methods.name: enableStatLogging
methods.description: Enables or disables statistical logging for inference performance.

methods.name: getStatString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing inference statistics.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the TensorFlow inference interface and releases resources.
